description:
FILED s465 (Fable, 2026-09-02) from the USER decision on docs/plan-test-audit-s464.md Â§5.2 ("Out of scope, registered as a class").

THE CLASS (companion snapshot baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv, s465): files whose rows are Unicode case folding / case mapping / property tables:
  uni/fold.t 18,072 perl rows (DIFF, early abort), uni/lower.t 11,720 (DIFF, 0 PCL rows), uni/upper.t 6,228, uni/title.t 5,936 (0 PCL rows), re/reg_fold.t 6,891 (0 PCL rows), re/uniprops01.t .. uniprops10.t (XDIFF, registered "measures perl internals", 0 PCL rows, ~325,000 rows), re/fold_grind_8/u/l/aa/a/d.t (213+213+113+103+31+31, all 0 PCL rows).  ~370,000 perl rows in one class.

WHAT THIS TASK OWNS:
  1. A docs/not-supported.md section ("Unicode case folding and property tables") naming the class, the file list, and that the case-fold tables PCL has (sb-unicode) are not perl's (version, special casing, locale) -- written s465 by Fable.
  2. Phase 1 of the audit (plan Â§4) STILL reads each member's first error (transpile alone, read the abort) so the cause is NAMED in the I2 shortfall baseline: a 0-PCL-row file is a crash, and a crash reason is a fact even when the class is deferred.  A member whose first error is NOT a Unicode-table gap (e.g. a lexer bug on the file's prologue) is a separate fix target and leaves the class.
  3. Post-v0.2: decide the implementation (perl's own tables from the perl-5.40.3 lib/unicore, generated into a CL table, vs sb-unicode + a special-casing shim), measure rows per approach, then schedule.

RELATED: #477 (quadratic pos, uni/variables.t TIMEOUT -- NOT this class), #993 (the audit), docs/plan-test-audit-s464.md Â§2d.
